Surveys – Collect product feedback with PostHog

## Ask anything with no-code surveys

Surveys is one of the tools that makes your product self-driving: the user feedback agents use to see what works. Built to natively work with product analytics, session replay, feature flags, and experiments.

### Install with AI in a single prompt

Paste into your terminal or code editor and make AI do the work.

## What does it do?

Surveys let you ask users anything right inside your product – freeform text, multiple choice, NPS, ratings, emoji reactions – as a no-code popup or via the API. Target by URL, person properties, events, or Feature Flags so you ask the right people at the right moment. Responses connect to Product Analytics and Session Replay, so you can see who answered and what they were doing.

## Who is it for?

Surveys is used across teams depending on your role.

Use cases

Product Managers

Run NPS, PMF, and CSAT surveys, or book user interviews from in-app templates

Product Engineers

Gather beta feedback tied to feature flags after a rollout

Growth Engineers

Ask the right cohort at the right moment – after activation, purchase, or churn

Support Engineers

Trigger satisfaction surveys after solved tickets and route urgent feedback to Slack

Founders

Collect testimonials and qualitative signal without a separate survey tool

Survey Setup — In-Product Surveys, NPS & Feedback | Pyze Documentation

# Survey Setup — In-Product Surveys, NPS & Feedback

Targeted in-product surveys, NPS/eNPS, and always-on feedback.

Collect feedback in the flow of work — event-triggered microsurveys, NPS/eNPS, and always-on feedback widgets — with frequency capping and segment targeting. Build a survey once, choose when and to whom it shows, and every response ties back to the respondent’s behavior.

Question & survey types

- NPS and eNPS (0–10) with automatic promoter / passive / detractor scoring
- Rating questions — star, smiley, or number scales (3 to 10 points)
- Single- and multiple-choice, ranking, and picture selection
- Open text with email, URL, number, and phone input variants
- Matrix, consent, date, address, and contact-info questions
- A call-to-action card for in-product announcements and prompts
- Welcome screens and custom thank-you screens — end on a message with a call-to-action button, or redirect to a URL
- Multi-step flows with branching logic, computed variables, recall (pipe an earlier answer into a later question), hidden fields, and per-survey languages

Triggering & display

- Code-triggered surveys fired from a custom event in your app
- No-code triggers — page view, element click, exit intent, and 50% scroll — with URL matching rules
- Frequency capping: show once, show again after a recontact wait, or limit total displays
- Sampling by percentage, an initial delay, auto-close, and a start
